description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three different gating conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.02 at layer 0, drops to nearly 0.0 by layer 1, and remains steady at 0.0 through layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It begins at a peak of approximately 0.84 at layer 0, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 0.42 at layer 1, and continues to decrease gradually to near 0.02 by layer 13. It then exhibits minor fluctuations, with a small peak near 0.08 at layer 21, before ending at approximately 0.05 at layer 23. The "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080" is depicted by a green dash-dot line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.78 at layer 0, drops sharply to about 0.28 at layer 1, and steadily declines until it flattens out near 0.01 around layer 10, maintaining this value through to layer 23.
